about.heading: Why we built GLPConvert
about.body: Clinics and med spas already pay for GLP-1 interest—ads, SEO, and referrals. Too much of that traffic stalls on uncertainty: what happens next, what it typically costs, and whether someone is ready for a consult. GLPConvert is a white-label layer that runs before the booking: calm education, expectation clarity, consult readiness, then handoff to your scheduler or CRM. It is not telehealth, prescribing, or an EMR—it's the front of the funnel, done in a way patients trust and buyers can activate without a sales meeting.
